findings.reason: SCIM 2.0 inbound provisioning remains live identity surface; higher ADRs (0553, 0567, 0631, 0218, 0536) implement or cite SCIM without superseding or amending ADR-0190. No later Accepted lists supersedes/amends ADR-0190.
Edge-vs-origin authz tier split remains normative; ADR-0384 cites Cedar basis (and corrects a mis-cite of 0193→0191) without superseding. No later Accepted lists supersedes/amends ADR-0191.
Milvus remains canonical vector substrate; ADR-0336/0337 explicitly do not amend it; ADR-0255/0239/0339 continue to cite it. No later Accepted lists supersedes/amends ADR-0192.

ClickHouse remains canonical OLAP compute; ADR-0337 (Proposed) layers Iceberg table-format under ClickHouse and does not supersede 0193; Accepted consumers (0479, 0480, 0565) still cite ClickHouse. No later Accepted lists supersedes/amends ADR-0193.
TimescaleDB tenant-facing time-series decision has no later supersedes/amends edges; only band-internal related cites from ADR-0195. Leave Accepted.

Stream-processing policy (ClickHouse MV + Kafka Engine default; Flink by amendment) is not superseded. ADR-0557 (Accepted) supersedes ADR-0005 Kafka backbone only and relates to 0195; ADR-0397 (Proposed) explicitly leaves formal supersession of 0195 open. Body mischaracterization of 0195 in 0557/0397 is not high-confidence authority to change 0195 frontmatter.

ADR-0520 (Accepted) amends ADR-0196 (SeaweedFS/Ceph transitional behind object-store-kernel). Frontmatter already has amended_by: [ADR-0520]. Status remains Accepted (amended, not superseded). No further edge fix.

3-prong backup substrate remains cited (e.g. ADR-0340 capacity model). ADR-0343 extends DR RTO/RPO matrix and allowlist without superseding Velero/pgBackRest/Restic. No later Accepted lists supersedes/amends ADR-0197.
Karpenter NodePool policy remains live input for ADR-0340 capacity model and ADR-0375 fleet substrate; no later Accepted supersedes or amends ADR-0198.

Per-tenant label block + FOCUS 1.3 + chargeback remain; body already ladders OpenCost (Phase 0) to in-house aggregator (Phase 2). ADR-0480 retires OpenCost and supersedes ADR-0443 only — does not claim supersedes/amends ADR-0199. Inventing Superseded or amended_by would exceed high-confidence rule.
